title: Cash Flow Mapping
instructions: Choose only from allowed mapping or semantic concept keys supplied in the request.
Do not invent keys, buckets, rows, sections, or accounts.
Use operating cash flow as a catch-all only when no clear investing or financing signal exists.
Treat contribution, subscription, equity injection, capital call, and partner funding language as financing inflow.
Treat debt drawdown, borrowings, and loan proceeds as financing inflow.
Treat repayments, dividends, distributions, redemptions, and interest paid as financing outflow when allowed.
Treat capex, asset purchases, software capitalization, and investment purchases as investing outflow.
Treat asset sale proceeds and investment sale proceeds as investing inflow.
Use sample GL descriptions as evidence when the account name alone is generic.
Prefer the specific allowed mapping with the strongest accounting meaning over generic fallback buckets.
Flag ambiguity for human review rather than forcing a weak match.
